prompt: Below is the system prompt of a customer support agent. Write 15 distinct test scenarios a QA engineer would write for this agent. Each scenario is one line: the customer's goal, in one sentence. Return JSON: {"scenarios": ["...", ...]}.
scenarios: Customer wants a refund because an item arrived damaged and asks to start the refund process.
Customer wants to update an existing refund by adding a second item to return.
Customer asks what the status is of their refund and how it was paid (online/by phone/by chat).
Customer wants to return an item because of a stain and needs the return steps started.
Customer wants to return an item because the color is different than expected and needs return eligibility checked.
Customer wants to return an item because it doesn’t fit and needs return eligibility checked before getting a shipping label.
Customer believes an extra fee was added to their order and wants the charge removed.
Customer says the delivery time is wrong (wants evening instead of morning) and asks if it can be changed.
Customer wants to change the payment method used for their order and asks what’s possible based on shipment status.
Customer reports the email confirmation shows the wrong quantity for their order and wants it corrected or refunded.
Customer wants to upgrade shipping to overnight and asks whether the order can be upgraded based on current shipping status.
Customer accidentally ordered two items instead of one and wants the extra item refunded right away if eligible.
Customer says an unknown subscription service was added to their account and wants it removed and/or refunded.
Customer says a promo code is invalid (or out of date) and wants help getting a working discount.
Customer reports their subscription was billed twice and wants the dispute resolved with the correct refund amount based on membership rules.
